seasons.label: Atlantic Hurricane Season
seasons.relevance: Operational risk for all Caribbean stakeholders. Monitoring NHC/NWS/NDBC for tropical development and maritime hazards.
seasons.action: Review contingency plans and ensure resilience routing is active

seasons.label: Tourism High Season
seasons.relevance: Peak tourism revenue window. GDP, airlift, and booking data most actionable during booking and arrival periods.
seasons.action: Monitor tourist demand indicators for capacity planning

seasons.label: Tourism Shoulder Season
seasons.relevance: Post-peak period. Early indicators of summer demand trajectory are most valuable now.
seasons.action: Track early summer booking and airlift data

seasons.label: Q2 Procurement Cycle
seasons.relevance: CDB and IDB typically issue mid-year procurement rounds in Q2. Pipeline data especially actionable now.
seasons.action: Review procurement pipeline for active bidding opportunities

seasons.label: Q3 Procurement Cycle
seasons.relevance: Late-summer procurement cycle. New project announcements common before fiscal year-end.
seasons.action: Monitor new project announcements for bid pipeline

seasons.label: Regional Budget Planning
seasons.relevance: Caribbean governments and development banks finalize annual budgets. Infrastructure and investment signals carry extra weight.
seasons.action: Cross-reference investment signals with budget priorities

events.label: Future Caribbean Buildathon
events.relevance: Regional innovation event approaching. Ecosystem builder and founder-matching dispatches most actionable now.
events.action: Route investment and pipeline signals to buildathon participants

events.label: CARICOM Heads of Government Meeting
events.relevance: Regional policy decisions expected. Development pipeline and investment signals may indicate pre-summit momentum.
events.action: Monitor policy signals and procurement announcements before summit

events.label: IDB Annual Meeting
events.relevance: IDB project pipeline and funding announcements typically cluster around annual meetings.
events.action: Review IDB project pipeline for new funding windows

events.label: World Bank Spring Meetings
events.relevance: New development financing and project announcements expected from World Bank group.
events.action: Track new financing announcements for Caribbean region

events.label: COP Climate Summit
events.relevance: Climate resilience funding and vulnerability signals most salient in lead-up to COP. Food security and economic vulnerability dispatches gain political weight.
events.action: Compile vulnerability and food security signals for policy audience
